realMachineTests.transcript: review-inventory-epoch-smoke.ts asserts signed epoch verify, tampered-hash reject, begin text (epoch id / State: OPEN / frozen cutoff / exactly one Next), and process-fact contract registration of review-inventory-epochs.json. review-inventory-handler-smoke.ts persists one epoch across store reload.

epoch-smoke asserts a material mutation while OPEN invalidates the epoch and status Next becomes review_inventory_begin. prewrite-guard.ts rejects material targets with OPEN_REVIEW_INVENTORY_MATERIAL_MUTATION. epoch-smoke also asserts a pure verification_evidence re-pin does not move the acceptance-subject digest, while an observed-result change does.

epoch-smoke + handler-smoke cover: all required lanes pending vs terminal, missing readLog cannot terminate a lane, critic dispositions (verified_family/duplicate/not_verified/unknown/conflict), suspected findings excluded from families, wave_advance for nonzero waves, finalize rejected without persist when new families remain, zero-new finalize mints authorizesTest=false receipt, budget exhaustion emits REVIEW_INVENTORY_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED and never PASS.

epoch-smoke asserts reviewInventoryRemediationGate ok on a valid unconsumed FINALIZED receipt, rejects wrong reviewRound, rejects artifact absence (next=review_inventory_begin), rejects already-consumed receipts, leaves phase=REVIEW when consumption fails before phase write, and cancel cannot grant DEV. machine.ts canReenterDevGuard consumes the same gate.

epoch-smoke replay counters are derived from operations, asserted deterministic across two runs, and require baseline mutation-driven redispatches >= 5 vs proposed 0, required host count 2->2, unchanged required lane count, and critical/high escapes + budget-manufactured PASS = 0. Missing/ambiguous baseline attribution is inconclusive rather than PASS.

machine.ts evaluateReviewVerdict consumes computeFinalReviewRoster instead of the old round-2+ single-receipt shortcut. reviewer-list.ts projects Final-review lanes and dependency-closure/full-set Selection. epoch-smoke asserts a post-remediation regression reopens discovery. review-incremental-context.ts signs the post-remediation selection from current hashes, scope, cutoff, and dependency closure.

closingSelfCheck.summary: B-3f3d delivered the frozen review-inventory epoch, saturation critic/wave/finalize path, OPEN-epoch mutation barrier, and mandatory REVIEW-to-DEV consumption, with handler+epoch smokes covering happy, tamper, stale, budget, cancel, and replay edges. Wave 4 enforce consumers exist and independently report the current rollout report as full-3x2 but stale; observe-mode topology/pre-review are diagnostic only. Open follow-up bugs and the documented F-107 freshness leak are not claimed closed.
